# Lucide Icons

Shelf-School vendors the Lucide browser build version 0.468.0 for offline use.

- Project: https://lucide.dev/
- Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
- License: ISC; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The icons are initialized from `templates/library/base.html` and marked
decorative where an adjacent text label already provides the accessible name.
